summary: Enhance your NGO's impact with our Data-Driven Project Management training course. Learn to leverage data for effective decision-making and project success.
lede: An M&E system for NGOs provides a structured way to track project activities, measure results and inform decisions. This course is for NGO project staff responsible for performance, data collection or accountability, and covers building M&E plans with indicators and logframes, choosing quantitative and qualitative data methods, and analyzing findings for reporting and adaptive management.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals working in NGOs, international development agencies, and humanitarian organizations who are responsible for project performance and accountability.
modules: Applying M&E to NGO Projects - Case Studies and Best Practices
